zones.title: Seed
zones.body: Rows live in the Edit Fields nodes as JSON; Split Out makes one item per row; upserts are keyed on the natural key. Run once per environment; safe to re-run.

panels.title: AR-90 Seed config
panels.body: Markets, codes and prompts are data, not code: a new market is one row, a wording change is one cell. Disclosure texts are placeholders until Legal supplies the market wording.
